Title: Text Diff Viewer
Description: Compare two texts or files line by line: added, removed and changed lines shown side by side or as a unified diff, with word-level highlights.
Keywords: text diff, diff checker, compare text, compare two files, side by side diff, unified diff, code diff, diff viewer online
ErrorMessage: Please enter text in both fields to compare.
LibraryLoadError: The diff viewer library failed to load. Please refresh the page.
Seo_Introduction: Paste two versions of a config file, code snippet or document and see exactly which lines were added, removed or changed — in a side-by-side or line-by-line (unified) view similar to a Git diff.
Seo_DetailedDescription:
The comparison is line-based: jsdiff builds a unified patch and diff2html renders it with line numbers, up to 4 unchanged context lines around each change and word-level highlighting inside modified lines. Only the changed regions (hunks) are shown, not the whole text. Whitespace and letter case are significant, so a changed indentation or trailing space counts as a change.

Each side can be typed, pasted or loaded from a local text file (read as UTF-8). Line endings are normalized, so a Windows (CRLF) file and a Unix (LF) file with the same lines are reported as identical. When both sides are loaded from files, the comparison starts automatically; identical inputs report that there are no differences.

The diff is computed in your browser and files are read locally — nothing is uploaded. To keep the page responsive, very different texts are capped: if more than 1,000 lines differ, the tool shows a message instead of a diff.
Seo_Examples:
**Config change**: original lines `host=localhost`, `port=8080`, `debug=true` against `host=0.0.0.0`, `port=8080`, `debug=false` — the host and debug lines are marked as removed and added with the changed words highlighted, while `port=8080` stays as unchanged context.

**One line in a long file**: in a 20-line text where only line 11 changed, the diff shows a single hunk `@@ -7,9 +7,9 @@` — the change plus 4 lines of context on each side.

**Comparing two files**: choose the old and the new version with the file buttons; the diff appears as soon as both are loaded.

**Checking a copy**: comparing two identical texts reports that no differences were found.
Seo_HowToSteps:
### Step 1: Add the original
Paste text into **Original Text** or press **Choose original file**.

### Step 2: Add the modified version
Paste text into **Modified Text** or press **Choose modified file**.

### Step 3: Compare
Press **Compare**. When both sides come from files, the diff appears automatically.

### Step 4: Switch the view
Under **View mode**, choose **Side by Side** or **Line by Line**; **Clear** resets both fields.
Seo_Tips:
- **Side by Side** is easier to read on wide screens, **Line by Line** on phones.
- Only plain text can be compared; images, PDF or Word documents are not supported.
- If more than 1,000 lines differ, compare the files in smaller parts.
- Reformat JSON or minified code first (one item per line) — a single long line produces a single changed line.
- After the first visit the page also works without a network connection.
